item.title: Does Poor Sleep Lead to Injuries?
item.description: Those who reported poorer sleep on average (in response to the question “How was your sleep last night?”, on a scale of 1 to 6) were significantly more likely to subsequently get injured. In fact, for every one-point decrease in sleep quality, they were 36 percent more likely to report an injury. The post Does Poor Sleep Lead to Injuries? appeared first on Outside Online.
